description: Which schema construct expresses each conformance capability. Checked in CI: every capability the corpus declares has an entry, every entry resolves to a real location in the schema, and every capability has a fixture that exercises it. This is what makes 'the schema is derived from the conformance corpus' a checkable statement rather than a claim in a README.

range_scoped_coverage.note: A segment states the span of the release it covers, so an edge need not apply to the whole release.

non_zero_offset.note: target = source + offset, within a segment.

dual_numbering.note: Season and absolute are separate modes, so a target exposing both diverging sequences gets one segment for each rather than a choice between them.

cross_boundary_span.note: Coverage is an array. A release crossing a target season boundary carries one segment per season, each with its own offset. A single block could express only one of them.

discontinuous_coverage.note: Same array. Non-adjacent ranges are separate segments, which is what regional episode skips and arc-split long-runners require.

cardinality_expand.note: kind=expands, constrained to one source and two or more targets. A constant offset is injective and cannot express this at all.

cardinality_merge.note: kind=merges, constrained to two or more sources and exactly one target. The inverse of expands and strictly harder, because inverting a scalar map gives one key two values.

numbering_space.note: Specials, trailers, credits and parodies are separate sequences. Numbers are comparable only within one, so a trailer numbered 1 and an episode numbered 1 do not collide.

negative_assertion.note: relation=not_same_as requires reasoning. Storing the refutation is what stops an automated pass re-deriving the same bad merge.

alternate_cut.note: alternate_cut_of links sibling releases that are the same work in a different edit, without merging them into one entity.

multi_series_membership.note: A list, never a single parent. A recap film belongs to its own line and to the parent series at once.

known_absent.note: A checked absence with a reason, distinct from an unchecked field. That distinction is the whole value of recording it.

ordering_variance.note: Where broadcast, chronological and intended orders differ there is no single correct sequence, so the ordering a mapping is correct relative to is part of the assertion.
